$comment: Platform-neutral source of truth for the Halo design system. Mirrored by _tokens.scss (web/Angular) and, later, a Flutter theme. WHITE-LABEL MODEL: clients set two brand knobs (primary, secondary) from an external admin app; everything interactive is derived. The BASE theme is brand-neutral; a SKIN (e.g. volleytv) only sets the knobs + per-theme accent lead + tinted surfaces. Logos are client-supplied (see ClientLogo), not tokens. Regenerated 2026-08-21 from _tokens.scss (theme sweep + Track B token families).

knobs.$comment: Admin-editable at runtime by setting these vars inline on the .halo root (inline style overrides the skin).

derived.$comment: Computed from the knobs in _tokens.scss — do not set directly per client.

shared.$comment: Theme-independent. on-media = white ink over imagery/video/scrims (media is dark in both themes). live-strong = filled badge red carrying white text (AA). player.* = the always-dark video-player chrome. a11y CONTRACT: on-tint inks must clear AA on the darkest common surface (screen/card2), not just white.

premium.$comment: Fixed platform gold — premium never re-skins with client brand (Yoni 2026-08-22)

dark.$on-primary-note: dark ink on the bright fill (BA-dark pattern): white was 3.33:1 on every filled control; dark ink is 5.72:1. The knob stays bright — it doubles as text-accent on dark surfaces.

volleytv.label: Volley TV
volleytv.$comment: Placeholder tenant brand for the volleyball click-dummy (2026-09-08). Coral + deep teal, ink #0b1a22. Dark coral-led, light teal-led.

type.$comment: px. Roles, not t-shirt sizes. fs-* = body (Inter), fs-d-* = display (League Spartan). A ratio scale, deliberately NOT on the 4px rhythm grid. A hardcoded font-size is a defect: the accessibility text steps re-derive this scale and cannot reach a literal. Rendered in the Tokens/Typography story; rules in Tokens/Typography · Rules.

space.$comment: One 4px rhythm grid addressed through semantic roles. space-N is the primitive ladder where N x 4 = the value; everything else names a role. Raw px spacing in a component is a defect. Values below 4px (sub-grid optical corrections) and above space-12 (layout dimensions, not rhythm) stay literals and must state a reason.

breakpoints.$comment: min-width. CSS vars can't be read inside @media — these are the canonical values to hardcode.

z.$comment: Overlay ladder only; component-internal layering (1-15) stays local. Scrim = band value, panel = band+1 (+10 in modal band).

motion.$comment: Interactive feedback = fast, standard state = med, entrances = slow. Ambient loops stay bespoke.
